episodes.title: Romance Dawn
episodes.summary: Stranded on a sinking boat, carefree Luffy begins his journey in search of a pirate king's lost treasure. But first, he'll need a crew, a ship and a map.

episodes.title: The Man in the Straw Hat
episodes.summary: After securing a map to the Grand Line, Luffy, Nami and Zoro are taken hostage by a no-nonsense clown. New cadet Koby is cornered by Vice-Admiral Garp.

episodes.title: Tell No Tales
episodes.summary: In need of a proper ship, the gang reaches Syrup Village and meets the cheerful Usopp and his best friend Kaya. A sinister threat disrupts their plans.

episodes.title: The Pirates Are Coming
episodes.summary: With his friends in danger and Klahadore's plan in motion, Usopp seeks help from the Marines. Blades clash when a fierce battle erupts at Kaya's mansion.

episodes.title: Eat at Baratie!
episodes.summary: The Straw Hat Pirates face their first adversary as a group. At a floating fish house, Luffy befriends a cook, and Zoro enters a duel with a warlord.

episodes.title: The Chef and the Chore Boy
episodes.summary: Sanji and head chef Zeff put their differences aside to save a severely wounded Zoro. A ruthless Fishman on a mission stirs up trouble for the crew.

episodes.title: The Girl with the Sawfish Tattoo
episodes.summary: After striking a deal with a familiar foe to find Arlong, Luffy and his friends set sail for Coco Village and learn about Nami's mysterious past.

episodes.title: Worst in the East
episodes.summary: The Straw Hat crew strives to take down Arlong and the Fishmen once and for all. After a tense family reunion, Luffy inches closer to his dreams.

episodes.title: The Beginning and the End
episodes.summary: To prepare for the Grand Line, the Straw Hats visit Loguetown, birthplace of the Great Pirate Era — where rivals both old and new await.

episodes.title: Good Whale Hunting
episodes.summary: When the Merry lands in the belly of a giant whale, Luffy must win over a gruff lighthouse keeper to save his friends and his ship.

episodes.title: Whisky Business
episodes.summary: The crew receives a warm welcome to the pirate-loving town of Whisky Peak. But with a pair of assassins on the loose, trouble isn't far behind.

episodes.title: Big Trouble in Little Garden
episodes.summary: A new addition to the ship raises the stakes. On the lush isle of Little Garden, the crew encounters an adventure of giant proportions.

episodes.title: Wax On, Wax Off
episodes.summary: The Straw Hats are held captive by two artists: one who colors emotions, and one intent on making them part of his latest — and deadliest — masterwork.

episodes.title: Nami Deerest
episodes.summary: When Nami is stricken by a mysterious illness, Luffy and Sanji embark on a perilous mission to save her. Smoker and Tashigi investigate a Marine outpost.

episodes.title: Reindeer Shames
episodes.summary: Dr. Kureha tells the heartwrenching story of Chopper's origins, including how he met his mentor Dr. Hiriluk and their quest to cure all disease.

episodes.title: Deer and Loathing in Drum Kingdom
episodes.summary: The Straw Hats lend themselves to Drum Island's cause when King Wapol and his army of monsters return to reclaim the throne.
